newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates steady on funds shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates steady on funds shortage.

text.p: Pakistan's interbank rates stayed higher on Tuesday amid a shortage of funds and dealers said rates were likely to open steady on Wednesday.
Overnight funds were traded in a range of 16.90 percent and 17 percent, one dealer said.

Dealers said banks approached the State (central) bank of Pakistan to square their positions and some 2.5 billion rupees were discounted. They said no major inflow was expected on Wednesday and the rates were likely to to stay firm.
